messages:
maria.k: Quick sync — I'm proposing a small, backwards-compatible error extension we can surface in the console and SDKs: add an `exposure_level` enum + `remediation_token` (i18n key) to error payloads. Example below.

kevin.s: can you paste the example payload? curious how it looks for 429 vs 5xx.

maria.k: sure — rough sketch: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
    "status": 429,
    "message": "rate limit exceeded",
    "exposure_level": "user_visible",
    "remediation_token": "errors.quota_exceeded.try_reduce_batch_size",
    "meta": {
      "tenant_budget_usd": "12.50",
      "route_hint": "dedicated-fallback"
    }
  }
}
```

shreya.p: +1 for `remediation_token` — allows console to show localized actions. but how do we avoid leaking internal routing reasons to customers? `route_hint` looks internal.

maria.k: good point. plan is: only surface `route_hint` to console tier admins (RBAC) and keep `exposure_level` + `remediation_token` safe for all callers. `route_hint` stays in telemetry and in admin-only error payloads.

dan.g: what are the `exposure_level` options? enum suggestion?

maria.k: thinking: `internal`, `admin`, `user_visible`. `internal` = only in our logs, `admin` = console for tenant admins, `user_visible` = returned to customers and SDKs.

kevin.s: how does this interact with SDKs that parse errors today? We shouldn't break clients that expect `code`+`message`.

maria.k: won't break — fields are additive. SDKs can opt-in to parse `remediation_token` and map to UI actions. we'll add a compatibility note in the changelog and bump minor semver.

shreya.p: telemetry: we need new tags so the console can show distribution of `exposure_level` per route. also we should record `remediation_token` usage (did user click suggested action).

dan.g: agree. instrument: `error.exposure_level`, `error.remediation_token`, `error.route_hint` (admin-only), and `ui.remediation_click` with tenant_id. event sizes ok?

kevin.s: event cardinality worry on `remediation_token` — could explode if we allow freeform tokens. Recommend a whitelisted token catalog with IDs (we already version it).

maria.k: yep — plan: maintain a central token registry in the control plane: stable token IDs, localized strings live in i18n repo. SDKs fetch the small token catalog (TTL cache).

rollouts-bot: Deploy preview for control-plane schema available in staging. Link: https://staging.redwood/err-schema-preview

shreya.p: UX on console: show a compact banner for `user_visible` errors with one-click recommended action (e.g., "Reduce request size"), and an expandable block for admins showing `route_hint` and runbook link.

dan.g: runbook links — should those come from `remediation_token` -> runbook URL mapping in control plane?

maria.k: yes, mapping stored server-side. clients only get token, not the full URL unless RBAC allows. reduces leak surface.

kevin.s: rollout plan? feature flag per-tenant?

maria.k: gradual rollout via feature flags: stage 1 (admin-only visibility) -> stage 2 (SDKs can parse but not show by default) -> stage 3 (full customer-visible). Each stage gated by telemetry checks for mismatch rates and error churn.

shreya.p: ping me for console mockups. i'll design the localized call-to-action components.

kevin.s: one more ask — ensure test harness generates synthetic `remediation_token` clicks so our alerting knows if CTA drives behaviour.

maria.k: noted. I'll add synthetic telemetry in the canary config.

dan.g: thumbs: :thumbsup: if we OK this, i'll file a tiny RFC for enum + token registry and add the schema migration to the runtime backlog.

maria.k: thanks — filing RFC now.

rollouts-bot: RFC created: https://go/redwood/rfc/error-exposure-2026 (assigned: dan.g, due: 2026-04-05)
